```{r data_prep}
# If you haven't already, source the file that defines the formulas:
# source("cfunc11.r")  # contains formula_time, formula_ln_price_no_ecf, formula_base, formula_ln_tasp, formula_alt :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
# If formula_base / formula_ln_tasp / formula_alt depend on ecfs_col, make sure it's defined:
# (Only needed if you're using those formulas and ecfs_col wasn't created earlier.)
if (!exists("ecfs_col")) {ecfs_col <- grep("^secf_", names(df), value = TRUE)}

# --- helper: build X and y for xgboost from ANY formula ---
make_xy_xgb <- function(data, formula, sparse = TRUE, drop_intercept = TRUE,
                        na_action = stats::na.omit) {
  # Freeze rows to the exact ones usable by this formula
  mf <- model.frame(formula, data = data, na.action = na_action)  # y = response
  y <- model.response(mf)
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  # Build terms for predictors only
  if (drop_intercept) {    # remove intercept from predictors (xgboost doesn't need it)
    tt <- delete.response(terms(update(formula, . ~ . - 1), data = mf))
  } else {tt <- delete.response(terms(formula, data = mf))}
  # X = model matrix (dense or sparse)
  X <- if (sparse) {Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(tt, data = mf)} else {
    stats::model.matrix(tt, data = mf)}

  list(X = X, y = y, feature_names = colnames(X), mf = mf)
}
# --- build X/y for each formula in cfunc11.r :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2} ---
xy_time            <- make_xy_xgb(df, codform$formula_time)
xy_ln_price_no_ecf <- make_xy_xgb(df, codform$formula_ln_price_no_ecf)
xy_base            <- make_xy_xgb(df, codform$formula_base)
xy_ln_tasp         <- make_xy_xgb(df, codform$formula_ln_tasp)
xy_alt             <- make_xy_xgb(df, codform$formula_alt)

# --- export as plain X / y variables (what you asked for) ---
X_time <- xy_time$X; y_time <- xy_time$y

X_ln_price_no_ecf <- xy_ln_price_no_ecf$X; y_ln_price_no_ecf <- xy_ln_price_no_ecf$y
X_base            <- xy_base$X;            y_base            <- xy_base$y

X_ln_tasp <- xy_ln_tasp$X; y_ln_tasp <- xy_ln_tasp$y
X_alt     <- xy_alt$X;     y_alt     <- xy_alt$y

# (Optional) xgboost DMatrix objects (usually what you actually feed xgboost)
dtime   <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_time,            label = y_time)
dprice0 <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_ln_price_no_ecf, label = y_ln_price_no_ecf)
dbase   <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_base,            label = y_base)
dtasp   <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_ln_tasp,         label = y_ln_tasp)
dalt    <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_alt,             label = y_alt)
```

## Model I

```{r}
df_taf_xgb <- make_time_adjusted_df_xgb(
  df = df,
  formula_time = formula_time,
  nrounds = 1000,
  verbose = 1
)
```




```{r mod1}
cod <- function(r) {
  r <- r[is.finite(r)]
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  100 * mean(abs(r - med), na.rm = TRUE) / med
}

prd <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  mean_r <- mean(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  wmean_r <- sum(p, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(a, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_r / wmean_r
}

prb <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  dev_pct <- (r - med) / med * 100
  vproxy <- (p + a) / 2
  x <- log(vproxy) - mean(log(vproxy), na.rm = TRUE)
  coef(lm(dev_pct ~ x))[["x"]] / 100
}

# Train/test split (quick)
set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(X_time)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.8 * n))
test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(n), train_idx)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = X_time[train_idx, , drop = FALSE],
  label = y_time[train_idx]
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = X_time[test_idx, , drop = FALSE],
  label = y_time[test_idx]
)

mod_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective = "reg:squarederror",eval_metric = "rmse"), data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 2000, watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  early_stopping_rounds = 50, verbose = 1
)

# Predict back on full df_xgb (or just test)
pred_ln <- predict(mod_xgb, newdata = dtest)
# df_xgb <- df %>%  mutate(pred_lnx = pred_ln, espx = exp(pred_ln), ratiox = espx / tasp)

df_test <- df[test_idx, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pred_lnx = pred_ln, espx = exp(pred_lnx), ratiox = espx / tasp)

assess_stats_xgb <- df_test %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(), median_ratio = median(ratiox, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ratio   = mean(ratiox, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ratio  = sum(espx, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(tasp, na.rm = TRUE),
    prd = prd(espx, tasp), cod = cod(ratiox), prb = prb(espx, tasp)
  )

assess_stats_xgb
```
